← Reading Habit Coach

Consistency, with breathing room.

Your reading habit can include days off.

How can I build a habit without daily streak pressure?

Choose a weekly target such as four reading days. Read on the days that suit you. A reading day has at least one logged minute.

An honest view of your progress

Completed calendar weeks determine the confirmed streak. The current week shows progress separately. Changes to weekly goals start next week; paused weeks preserve confirmed history without adding a week.

A small daily intention

Set daily reading minutes and an annual number of books. Lifetime reading totals remain when a weekly streak ends.
